Each row is a requirement this distribution's `pyproject.toml` declares. The version is
the one `uv.lock` resolves; the licence text is in `LICENSES/`, byte-identical to the
copy in every other tree that declares the same package.

| `defusedxml` | 0.7.1 | PSFL | `LICENSES/defusedxml.txt` | required |

- **`firecrawl-anydoc`**: its wheel ships no licence file at all, which is a finding about the package; this repository carries the text under vendor/ at a pinned SHA and tools/vendor.toml digests it
